- Wading Through the Ashes of Love BY Marcus Lane RELEASED_AT TODO
- Fading Like a Distant Star BY Hazel Winter RELEASED_AT TODO
- Wilted Grace BY Felix Blackwood RELEASED_AT TODO"""

lines = note_content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        title = parts[0].strip()
        rest = parts[1]
        # rest is "Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        artists_str = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})

print(todo_songs)
